hook_text: One square takes 4 matches. Ten squares in a row take 40. Right? Wrong!
clip_script: One matchstick square: 4 matches. Add a second square next to it. It shares a side! Only 3 new matches. 4, 7, 10, 13. Add 3 each time. So 10 squares? Not 40. Start with 1 match, add 3 for every square: 31. Now beads near Eshowe: square panels of 1, 4, 9, 16. Each new panel adds an L shape: 3, 5, 7. Panel 10? 10 times 10: 100 beads. Fold paper: 2, 4, 8, 16. Doubling! Count what is new.
visual_style: Matchsticks clicking into place with the shared side glowing, then bead panels growing with new L shapes in a bright colour, then paper folding.
mood: Hands-on and curious, like building at a desk.
pacing: A trick question, a slow build of squares, then quick growing beads and folding.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the border tiles for a pool 10 tiles long.
